summary: Event-driven backend automation verified. 22/22 pytest cases pass (100%). Validated: (1) AUTO-ROUTAGE via BackgroundTasks - water+Cocody -> EQUIPE_EAU_COCODY, zone=COCODY, priority=urgent_critique, status received->assigned within ~1s; waste+Yopougon -> EQUIPE_DECHETS_YOPOUGON, normal; drainage+Plateau -> EQUIPE_ASSAINISSEMENT_PLATEAU, urgent_critique; unknown address -> *_ZONE_INCONNUE. (2) NOTIFICATIONS audit log: PUT status=resolved logs 'email_citizen_resolved' with channel=EMAIL/simulated=true; auto-routing assignment logs 'sms_agent_assigned' with correct to_team. (3) GET /api/admin/notification-events returns {events:[...]} (admin only; citizen=403). (4) GET /api/reports/stats/summary includes new fields: assigned, urgent, escalated (all ints). (5) Filters status_filter/type_filter/priority_filter on /api/reports work correctly. (6) Regression OK: login (citizen+admin+invalid), citizen sees only own reports, admin sees all, citizen blocked from PUT, admin updates persist, /api/register-push endpoint exists (returns 500 with placeholder key as expected). (7) Scheduler: confirmed task_escalade_tickets_critiques function present, scheduler.add_job at minutes=15 in code, and 'Scheduler démarré - Tâche d''escalade toutes les 15min' line found in backend logs at startup. Mocked: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder -> push HTTP calls return 401 upstream which is caught non-blocking (logged 'Push notification échouée (non-bloquant)'); SMS/Email simulated via logger + notification_events collection.

minor.issue: Still returns 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (HTTPException raised before graceful fallback). Acceptable per spec; consider catching to return {status:'failed'} so mobile never sees 500. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:585-589

ReportUpdate.admin_notes branch uses 'if update_data.admin_notes is not None' correctly (line 735) — OK. But update_data.status uses 'if update_data.status' so empty string would be ignored (low impact since status values are always non-empty). Reference: /app/backend/server.py:731

Returns zone in uppercase but accented variants ('Adjamé','Attécoubé','Port-Bouët') get matched then their .upper().replace fixes only É/È/Ê. Works for current ZONES_CONNUES list, but if other accents (Ç, Ô, etc.) added later, would leak. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:355-369

action_items: Optional: make /api/register-push always graceful (catch HTTPException from placeholder key, return {status:'failed'}) so the Expo client never receives a 500.
Optional: fix passlib bcrypt warning by pinning bcrypt<4 (visible at startup, login still works).
Optional: add an admin endpoint to manually trigger task_escalade_tickets_critiques (useful for QA without waiting 15min and without DB manipulation).
Optional: extend ZONES_CONNUES normalization to handle additional French accents generically (unicodedata.normalize).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:382-435 - router_automatiquement is robust: atomic update via $set, derives priority from TYPES_CRITIQUES, fires notifications after update, all wrapped in try/except (background task won't crash app).

server.py:623-660 - POST /reports correctly publishes the routing event via BackgroundTasks; response returns the pre-routing doc (status=received, team_id=None) which is the correct event-driven contract (consumer polls or receives push).
server.py:705-752 - PUT /reports correctly captures old_status before update and only notifies if status changed. handle_status_change_notifications is non-blocking.
server.py:780-799 - /admin/notification-events excludes _id ({"_id":0}) so MongoDB ObjectId is not leaked. Datetime serialized to ISO. Good.
server.py:755-777 - stats endpoint returns all required new fields (assigned, urgent, escalated). count_documents calls are efficient.
server.py:806-818 - Scheduler properly added with replace_existing=True, started on startup, shut down on shutdown.

server.py:456 - alerter_superviseur_general computes age_hours assuming naive created_at; .replace(tzinfo=utc) is defensive but if created_at is already tz-aware, replace() loses info silently. Low risk since datetime.now(timezone.utc) is used at creation.
Pydantic V1 .dict() used at line 639 (location.dict()); fine but Pydantic V2 deprecation - prefer model_dump().
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers - functional but worth modernizing.
All endpoints under /api prefix; CORS configured; no ObjectId leakage in responses.
seed_data_creation: Tests create 4 TEST_-prefixed reports under citizen account (water/Cocody, waste/Yopougon, street/unknown, drainage/Plateau). Not cleaned up - small volume, useful for manual QA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_event_driven.py -v` (22 tests, ~4s). BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tests rely on background task completing within 8s (polling). Notification audit log queried via /api/admin/notification-events. Scheduler verified at code + log level only (cannot wait 15 min). Manual escalade trigger via DB insertion is documented as Optional in the original request and was skipped.
